summary: Level 1-220 (+ AI title levels 1-30 + LE research) leveling path, hunting spots, key quests and keys for the Shade (profession 15), written for AOBuddy10. The Shade is a SHADOWLANDS-ONLY profession: a free account cannot create one, so there is no froob Shade path and no level-200 wall - the whole 1-220 route assumes a paid account with Shadowlands. It is a dual-wield PIERCING melee class that fights from the side and the back: Sneak Attack (Backstab), Fast Attack, Dimach, huge evades and a wall of combat procs, with NO pets, NO implants and NO symbiants. In the implant slots a Shade wears Spirits (client ItemClass 5) that need no surgery clinic; for armour it wears spiritual Tattoos and Body Wraps. The leveling loop at every bracket is the same: keep Piercing (and therefore your weapon QL) at the top of your skill list, keep evades and AAD stacked so mobs miss you, keep an offensive proc running, open from behind for the Backstab, and never let two mobs on you at once. The route itself is the standard modern AO route (Arete Landing -> Condemned Subway -> Temple of Three Winds / Steps of Madness / Biomare -> Shadowlands gardens and hecklers -> Adonis/Penumbra/Inferno), with Shade-specific stops layered on: Lady Sheila Black at Arete for your first Spirit, the Illegally Modified Ofab Viper in the Subway, Fear-forged Blades at Steps of Madness, the Shade-locked Nippy John Stiletto, the QL120 Bloodlust from an Elysium quest, Sharl's Cybernetic Tattoo in Penumbra and the Syndicate Brain Spirit of Guile from the Xan Civilization chain.

brackets.petNotes: NO PETS - a Shade has no pet line at all; ignore any pet advice written for other professions. You start with two Worn Daggers (item 218395) and one self-castable nano, Whetstone Effect (nano 211154, Piercing +12) - verified as the Shade's startup nano in the OmniCell login code. Train PIERCING first and hardest: it is cost factor 1.0 for a Shade and it gates every weapon you will ever hold. Multi Melee, Melee Init, Sneak Attack and Dimach are also 1.0 (cheapest tier). Do not waste IP on any weapon skill other than Piercing / Sharp Objects / Martial Arts - every other weapon skill is cost factor 4.0 for a Shade.

Note the positional rule: Backstab wants you BEHIND a target that is busy fighting someone else, which is why a Shade is a natural team damage dealer and an awkward soloer.

froobVsPaid: THERE IS NO FROOB SHADE. The Shade is one of the two Shadowlands professions (the other is the Keeper) and a free account cannot create one - you need a paid subscription with the Shadowlands expansion before the profession even appears at character creation. That single fact changes the whole shape of the Shade's leveling path compared with an old-world profession: there is no free-to-play version of this class, no level-200 froob wall to plan around, and no 'RK-only' fallback route you would ever be forced onto. Practical consequences: (1) SHADOWLANDS is mandatory and is where the class lives - the garden/Sanctuary key network, the heckler grind, Dark Ruins, Alappaa, the Xan questlines, every Spirit camp and every tattoo and Body Wrap tier is Shadowlands content (the tattoo and wrap templates literally carry the Expansion stat-389 Shadowlands bit). (2) You still level through Rubi-Ka content for the first ~50 levels (Arete Landing, Condemned Subway, Temple of Three Winds, Steps of Madness, Biomare) and you keep coming back to RK for dailies, the Reck, Mantis Den, Inner Sanctum, Freelancers Inc and the prisoner dailies right up to 220 - the modern route is a braid of RK and SL, not one or the other. (3) ALIEN INVASION adds the parallel AXP / AI-level / perk track and two Shade-relevant weapons - the Shade-locked Special Edition Kyr'Ozch Rapier (level 150, Sector 7) and Aleksander's Blooded Punchknife (Alien City Generals / Fleet Admirals) - plus the Shadow and Counterweight perk lines. (4) LOST EDEN adds Personal and Global Research and the Ofab Viper Mk 1-6 weapon line, bought as Mk 1 with Victory Points and upgraded with Biomaterial. (5) LEGACY OF THE XAN adds Deceit of the Xan (TitleLevel 6 gate) via the Alien Thread / Mitaar Hero upgrade of the Beast's Lord/Lady of Deceit. In short: 'froob vs paid' is not a choice a Shade owner has - the only real expansion question is how much of AI/LE/LoX you own on top of the mandatory SL.
tips: A Shade has NO PETS. Any leveling advice you read that starts 'send the pet in' does not apply. You are the one standing in melee range, which is why evades and AAD are not optional.

A Shade CANNOT USE IMPLANTS. The retail implant trainer refuses a Shade outright ('You know your kind can't use implants, right?') and Vernon Godfray at Arete sends a Shade to Lady Sheila Black rather than Doctor Mason. You wear Spirits in the implant slots instead - and Spirits need NO surgery clinic, so you can swap them anywhere, any time.

A Shade WEARS NO SYMBIANTS either. With profession 15 only 14 symbiant templates come back usable out of the whole client set, and 12 of those are an unlocked client-data anomaly. Spirits (ItemClass 5, 844 templates, 841 of them Shade-locked) are the entire slot line. See shade-spirits.json.

PIERCING is the whole class. Shade skill cost factors (1.0 = cheapest): Piercing 1.0, Multi Melee 1.0, Melee Init 1.0, Sneak Attack 1.0, Dimach 1.0, Fast Attack 1.4, Riposte 1.4, Martial Arts 1.6, Sharp Objects 1.6 - and EVERY other weapon skill is 4.0. Never put IP into a 4.0 weapon skill.

Dual-wield is gated by your own Multi Melee, not by the weapon. Keep the Multiwield nano line current - Dual Defender (level 0) -> Double Cover (25) -> Twice the Shield (75) -> Double Fence (145) -> Duplex Wall (195), plus the level-0 Triple Wall (MultiMelee +180).

BACKSTAB needs two things at once: a weapon that carries the Sneak Attack special, AND 100+ Sneak Attack skill counted from gear, Spirits and tattoos but NOT from nano buffs. Plan the first 100 around level 20-25.

Backstab is positional and situational: you must be behind a target that is already fighting someone else. That makes a Shade excellent in a team and awkward solo - solo, you lean on Fast Attack, Dimach, procs and lifetap perks instead.

Keep an offensive proc running at ALL times. The Shade proc lines (Ritualistic -> Sacrificial -> Ceremonial, the Dissipation line, the Quintessence stuns/debuffs, Degeneration haste procs and Nanite Depravation) are most of your damage and most of your survivability.
Re-siphon your Spirits every ~20-30 levels. A Shade in stale Spirits has no attack rating, no evades and no Sneak Attack skill - and unlike implants, re-doing them costs nothing but the siphon.

Spirit Siphon is checked against the mob: the Athen Paladins 18.7 guide says it tests your Dimach against the mob's Nano Resist, so keep Dimach trained (it is cost factor 1.0 anyway) and siphon RED mobs so the Spirits you get are worth wearing.

Your nano requirements are high for your nano skills. The AO-Universe Shade guide says plainly that you will need help from a Meta-Physicist or an Agent to get the bigger self-buffs up. Line up a buffer before each nano gate (25, 50, 75, 100, 135, 145, 155, 165, 175, 185, 195, then 203/207/209/212/216/218/220).

Armour is tattoos and wraps, and the top tier is side-locked. Ectoplasm (any side) / Entophagous (Clan) / Sombreous (Omni) from level 1; Eric Miller (Clan/neutral) and Min-Li Jiu (Omni/neutral) at QL80-120 (Agility and Sense > 299); First Tier wraps at QL100-160; Second Tier at QL160-220; then Chosen (Omni) or Faithful (Clan) at QL220-300 - there is NO neutral final tier.
The AO-Universe Shade guide warns that you can end up levelling the Tier armour past the skills needed to equip it - check the Agility/Sense requirement of the next tier BEFORE you upgrade.
Since patch 18.7 a Shade can wear everything other professions can - token boards, helmets, back items. Token boards in particular are a large flat HP gain for a class that has little.

Weapon route, all verified in the client data: two Worn Daggers (start) -> Illegally Modified Ofab Viper (item 301714, Piercing 149, Subway ~20) -> Fear-forged Blade (151903, QL50, Steps of Madness ~35-40) -> Nippy John Stiletto (245605-245607, QL140-160, Shade-locked, TitleLevel 3) -> QL120 Bloodlust from the Elysium quest -> Piercing Evil (245766-245768, QL220-260) / Spear of Forbidden Ceremonies (247070-247080) -> Hacked Medi-Blade (274974/274978) -> Ofab Viper Mk 5/6, Uklesh's Talon (305525), Deceit of the Xan (280719).
Keep the QL120 Bloodlust forever even after you out-damage it - Shade players use it as an Agility/Sense buffing swap weapon when equipping higher-QL Spirits.

Do the garden key for YOUR side as soon as you land in each Shadowlands zone, then the Sanctuary key. They give hub travel and a safe rez point, and the Scheol key is a hard prerequisite for the two big Scheol questlines.
Watch the level-150 quest deadline: the Elysium block (Elmo Fitz, Ulf Reinhart, One Who Has Taken Vow of Truth, Prophetess) locks out at 150.

Run the daily/elite-daily ladder in parallel with whatever you are grinding: Subway (16-25), TotW (26), Biomare (61), Mantis Den 1/2/3 (101-200), Elysium/Scheol/Adonis Catacombs (120-200), Alappaa (201-214), LotV (215-220), plus DOJA chips and Battle Station.

Every Faffy-sourced level range in this file should be treated as guidance, not a gate.

The chart is written for the general player, not for a Shade. Where a spot is flagged as needing evades/AAD (Reck bog golems) it suits a Shade well; where it assumes a pet or a tank, a Shade will need a team. No Shade-specific efficiency data was found for any of these spots.

Spirit camp QLs and locations (Nascence QL10/30/50/50-65, Elysium QL70/80/80-95/165, Scheol QL90-115/100-115, Adonis QL120-140/130, Penumbra QL150-170/150-165, Inferno QL195-205) come from the AO-Universe Comprehensive Shade Guide only. The landmark names (Abandoned Crypt, Ergo's Cave, Lethe dungeons, Saccelum, Two Mountains, Sabre's Cradle, Cold Rock, Spade, Crippler Cave, Melting Pot, Mining Outpost) are NOT in the local playfield data - only the playfields themselves are (Nascense Frontier/Wilds/Swamp/Training Ground/Portal, the five Elysium zones, Scheol, Adonis, Penumbra, Inferno, Pandemonium, Alappaa, Dark Ruins Solo, Milky Way). Verify a landmark on the AO-Universe zone guide before you travel to it.

Which garden of each pair is Clan and which is Omni is confirmed ONLY for Nascence (AO-Universe: 'the Aban Clan Key or Thrak Omni key'). For Elysium/Scheol/Adonis/Penumbra/Inferno the pairing is stated here as 'one per side' without assigning sides. Weak local hint, not treated as proof: the Shade-usable QL50 tattoos named after two of the garden lords carry opposite side locks - Enel Gil's Raging Spirit Tattoo is Side Unequal 1 (not Clan) and Nar Shere's Temperamental Spirit Tattoo is Side Unequal 2 (not Omni). Check the AO-Universe page for your own side before starting.

The Sigd I-X ladder is fully verified as items (231085-231103, Shade-locked, QL bands as listed). HOW you obtain them is not: a Funcom-forums Shade thread says they are available 'from Scheol and Adonis normal gardens around level 100+'. No vendor, NPC or quest was confirmed for any Sigd tier in local data or on ao-universe.com / wiki.aodb.us. Treat the Sigd acquisition route as unknown.

Sharl's Cybernetic Tattoo is verified as an item (269511, QL200, Shade-locked, Agility > 774 / Sense > 629). The claimed '7% XP bonus and 50 Computer Literacy' and the '160-170, Penumbra key and quest' placement come from the Athen Paladins 18.7 Shade guide only; the exact Penumbra quest that awards it was not identified.

The Syndicate Brain Spirit of Guile is verified as an item (268357). The claim that it comes from the Xan Civilization Quest (Adonis) is second-hand (an aoitems.com/aoguide.org search result plus the Athen Paladins guide's 'ADO quest series'); the AO-Universe site carries BOTH an Adonis and a Penumbra Xan Civilization guide and this pass did not confirm which one pays the Syndicate Brain.

The Shade nemesis nano Shade's Caress (nano 266300) has minLevel 100 in the client data, but where you get the crystal was not verified. One search result says nemesis nanos are bought from the VP nano vendor in Tower shops; that was not confirmed for the Shade. See shade-nano-sources.json when it exists.

TitleLevel gates: this file uses the project's own extractor note (TL5 = 150+, TL6 = 190+, TL7 = 205+, tools/mp-weapon-extractor/Program.cs). The TL1-TL4 boundaries (used only for the Nippy John Stiletto's TL3 gate, described here as 'roughly level 50+') were NOT re-verified against local data.

Drop sources for the endgame weapons (Piercing Evil from Anitaap's Shadow, Spear of Forbidden Ceremonies from the Inferno Catacomb boss and the Lord of the Void, Nippy John Stiletto from Nippy Slither in the Adonis Abyss, Aleksander's Blooded Punchknife from Alien City Generals and Fleet Admirals, Uklesh's Talon from Uklesh the Beguiling, Illegally Modified Ofab Viper from the Subway strikers, Fear-forged Blade from Steps of Madness) are all from the AO-Universe Shade guide, the Funcom forums or the Athen Paladins guide. The ITEMS are verified in items.ocp; the DROP LOCATIONS are not local data. auno.org and aoitems.com, which would settle them, block automation.

The Athen Paladins 18.7 Shade guide was read through an automated summariser. Its coarse TL-by-TL route (TL1 newbie island then Nascence chimeras ~8, TL2 subway ~20 then Nascence predators/malahs/weavers and Crippler Cave, TL3 spirit-siphon mobs 35-60 then Ely 60-90 then Tinker Tower/Reck 90-150, TL4 Adonis/Dark Ruins 100-150, TL5 Penumbra 150-160 then Inferno 160-205, TL6 Inferno hard missions 205-220) broadly agrees with the Faffy chart but disagrees in places on exact levels. Where they differ this file follows Faffy, which is the more recent and more granular source.

The AO-Universe Shade guide's 'Jobe SL Starter area' crafting route for the Notum-Infused Silvertail Dagger (item 227096, QL15, Piercing 75) is STALE: AO-Universe's own nostalgia page states 'AS OF PATCH 18.7 THIS AREA IS NO LONGER AVAILABLE. FOR THE STARTER AREA PLEASE SEE: Arete Landing.' The dagger and its components still exist in the client data but the area you crafted them in does not. Do not plan around it.

OmniCell's own hit-points-per-level table has a Shade column, but the source comment states only the Soldier, Martial Artist, Engineer and Fixer columns were verified - so no Shade HP-per-level figure is quoted in this file.
Exact XP/SK split per bracket is not modelled: 'XP + SK' simply means you are in Shadowlands content where both bars move. No local XP table was consulted for the SL brackets.

The six 'Garden Key Shop - [zone]' items (295073-295078) and the two Pandemonium Sanctuary keys (295111 Dante's, 295112 Macciavelli's) are verified item names with no known acquisition route; both are listed as unknown rather than guessed.
